_instructions.usage_critical: ONLY Property Management Clients should appear in the main daily checklist (with HOT, Maint tags, urgent alerts). Revenue Management Clients should be filtered OUT of the daily checklist or placed in a separate tracking section.
_instructions.filtering_logic: When scanning sources (Gmail, Slack, Notion, OpenPhone), check if the property is in _property_management_clients. If yes, include in main checklist. If in _revenue_management_clients only, filter it to revenue section or exclude.
_instructions.lookup_strategy: 1. Extract property reference from source. 2. Check against PM clients first. 3. If found in PM clients, use actual_name in main checklist. 4. If only in revenue clients, route to revenue section. 5. If not found anywhere, flag for Maryann to classify.
_instructions.maintenance: Update _property_management_clients when new PM clients are added. Update _revenue_management_clients when new revenue-only clients join.
